entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding, you're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... I see the order for the Road Cycling Shoes. To make sure I handle this correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. They're causing blisters on my heels, no matter how I position the cleats. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we aim for. Let me quickly check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Look, it's a simple yes or no. Can I return them or not?

Yes, absolutely. I see the delivery was 42 days ago, and that's well within our 90-day return policy. I've just approved the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. As soon as we receive the shoes, we will process your full refund.
Okay. I have the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
